# Printiva — Print Automation Software & Photocopy Management System

> Printiva is India's print automation software and photocopy counter system for print shops, xerox centers, cyber cafes, and campus print counters. Customers scan a desk QR code from any phone camera, upload files, pay via UPI or cash, and the Windows Desktop Agent prints directly on existing physical printers in under 2 seconds.

## Direct Facts & Summary (For Search & Answer Engines)
- **What Printiva is**: A web + Windows 10/11 (64-bit) print shop automation system combining customer QR upload, automatic page-count & pricing calculation, Razorpay UPI verification, and direct Win32 Print Spooler dispatch.
- **Problem solved**: Eliminates manual WhatsApp file downloads, USB flash drive malware exposure, manual page counting, fake payment screenshots, and repetitive Ctrl+P print dialogs.
- **Pricing**: ₹100 for a 7-day trial, then ₹699/month or ₹7,499/year with unlimited customer orders and updates.
- **Desktop Agent specs**: Windows 10/11 (64-bit), < 48 MB RAM footprint, < 500ms spool dispatch latency, USB / Wi-Fi / Ethernet / WSD printers.

## Key Product Capabilities
- **Zero-App Customer QR Intake**: Customers scan the counter QR sticker using any smartphone camera to upload PDFs, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, and images (JPEG, PNG, WEBP).
- **Live Per-Page Pricing**: Automatically counts pages, separates B&W vs. color modes, calculates single-sided or duplex totals, and applies copy multipliers before payment.
- **Verified UPI & Cash Token Queue**: Online UPI/Card payments are verified server-side via Razorpay webhooks before spooling. Counter cash payments enter a token queue for one-click shop approval.
- **Dual-Printer Auto-Routing**: Mixed orders automatically route monochrome pages to laser printers and color pages to color ink-tank/laser machines.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **Which printers work with Printiva?** Any printer with a working Windows 10 or 11 driver—including HP LaserJet/Smart Tank, Canon imageCLASS/PIXMA, Epson EcoTank, Brother, Ricoh, Kyocera, Konica Minolta, Pantum, and Xerox.
- **Do print shops need a separate computer?** No. The agent uses < 48 MB RAM and runs in the background system tray on the shop's existing counter PC.
- **How does customer tracking work?** Each order provides a live tracking token/link at `/track` without requiring an app download.
